facts.statement: The Community Team held an all-day birthday party where the party moved to a different location each hour, and Community Team members hid nearby to hand out birthday cake.
facts.quote: Each hour from 9am PDT to 5pm PDT, they will be moving the party to a different location.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? / In The Works: Free Realms Birthday Preview
article_summaries.summary: A live-era SOE news post previewing Free Realms' first birthday celebration on April 29 (2010), with special in-game quests and rewards across the world plus an all-day Community Team party. The post gives no quest names, reward details, or exact posting date; it is captured 2010-04-05 and says it was posted 3 days, 18 hours before capture.
